english.description: Either on (at least) your 3rd playthrough or in Hard (or greater) difficulty, win the final battle without retrying! Playing in Hard or higher increases your likelihood of obtaining double-skill equipment!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_016

english.description: Either on (at least) your 4th playthrough or in Intense (or greater) difficulty, win the final battle without retrying! Play long enough in Hard to unlock this more challenging difficulty setting.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_017

english.description: Either on (at least) your 5th playthrough or in Chaos difficulty, win the final battle without retrying! Play long enough in Intense to unlock this ghastly difficulty setting. It's the only difficulty that offers a chance of obtaining triple-skill equipment!
english.displayName: A Life Torn Between Order and Chaos
english.name: TROPHY_ID_018

english.description: Shop Level will increase when you buy, sell, or fuse equipment at shops. This is proof that you've fist-bumped the invisible hand of capitalism enough to achieve maximum Shop Level. Secret menus unleashed!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_019

english.description: This is proof that you've collected all 36 anomalous orbs. You've poked around in every nook and cranny, you've laughed, you've cried, you've questioned your assumptions... But you made it!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_020

english.description: This is proof that you've picked more than 100 herbs. Don't hesitate to use them when your initial SC gets low and you're stranded far from town.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_021

english.description: This is proof that you've stayed at inns for a total of 10 nights. Resting at inns can give you extra skill effects in battle thanks to mysterious ingredients in the meals you're served. You can also engage in chitchat with your companions and restore your initial SC to 100. Such hospitality!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_022

english.description: This is proof that you've honed a certain Support Talent enough to be able to teach it to others at the inn. Those who can, do. Those who can even better, teach!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_023

english.description: This is proof that you've found all the stone monoliths and ruminated on their author. Use the battle actions you've acquired to unleash the ultimate mystic artes!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_024

english.description: This is proof that you've found at least 40 normin and convinced them to help out. You're great at making new friends! But remember, there's more to come.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_025

english.description: This is proof that at least one Lord of the Land has reached Blessing Level 20. Even when they pass to the stars, they find it hard to abandon those over whom they watch. It seems some remnant of their blessing remains even after you finish the game.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_026

english.description: This is proof that you've equipped items that activate a Group Union bonus skill. Each basic skill group has a skill corresponding to each of the five elements. It doesn't matter where on your equipment you have the skills equipped; just equip all five skills in a group to form a Group Union!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_027

english.description: This is proof that you've equipped items that activate an Elemental Union bonus skill. Basic skills all correspond to one of five different elements. Equip skills of the same element that line up directly adjacent to each other, and you'll form an Elemental Union based on how many skills are in the line. Check it out on the skill sheet!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_028

english.description: This is proof that you've equipped items that activate a Stack bonus skill. You can get Stack bonuses by equipping more than one copy of the same skill at once. The more copies of that skill you equip, the cooler your Stack bonus will be!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_029

english.description: This is proof that you've reached the maximum Blast Gauge of 9. You can increase your BG using the Stack 3 bonus skill "Blasst". Coordinate your equipment just right, and you can blast off to new heights.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_030

english.description: This is proof that you've created an item of equipment with the same skill in all four slots. That's at least a Stack 4 bonus skill right there! You can do the Bonus Dance. We won't judge you.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_031

english.description: This is proof that you've equipped every skill for a certain element to achieve an E-Union 10 bonus skill. That strange buzzing you hear? It's your enemies quivering in fear.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_032

english.description: This is proof that you've achieved the Stack 16 bonus skill, the highest echelon of Stack bonuses. Whether this is the end or just the beginning is up to you.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_033

english.description: This is proof that you've sanctified at least one piece of equipment. A super deal that doubles the effect of the skill in the first slot! Of course, if you're particularly devout, you can also offer this item to the Lord of the Land and secure a more blessed future for our children.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_034

english.description: This is proof that you've acquired equipment with a doubled skill from an enemy drop. Very difficult unless you're playing in Hard difficulty or higher! There's a rumor that offering sanctified equipment to a Lord of the Land may increase the chances...
english.name: TROPHY_ID_035

english.description: This is proof that you've acquired a piece of equipment with a +99 modifier. Sanctify it, and a whole new life awaits you. Aim for 9900 fusions! No, wait, that's probably not necessary.
english.displayName: Last Stop on the Fusion Train
english.name: TROPHY_ID_036

english.description: This is proof that you've mastered at least one of the Support Talents. Slow and steady. You can do it. We believe in you.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_038

english.description: This is proof that you've received over 50 Grade from one battle. Everyone's amazed that you didn't buckle under the pressure. You've come so far.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_039

english.description: This is proof that you've prepared all available snacks. "The people in my video game eat nothing but cake all day, so I'm sorry, Doctor, you're full of it."
english.name: TROPHY_ID_040

english.description: This is (WHOOSH) proof that you've attained (NEEEAAAROOOOMMM) maximum speed with the (BEEEOOOWWWWWWWW) Windstepping talent.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_041

english.description: This is proof that you've fought many battles while controlling many characters. You can take it slow by changing characters in the Top Menu, but if you want to kick it into high gear, there are battle actions that let you switch in battle on the fly!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_042

english.description: Sometimes, after you've found a discovery point or when you're at a save point, you have the opportunity to press Enter/Back to initiate a conversation between your companions. This is proof that you've experienced many Things and had a lot of Opinions about them.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_043

english.description: This is proof that you've collected all items, most of which is equipment. The core concept of equipment is the combination of stat boosts and embedded skills. Items you initially dismissed might in fact hold the key to defeating the most formidable foes.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_044

english.description: This is proof that you've battled a wide swath of enemies. By the way, the more of the same enemy you defeat, the more likely that enemy becomes to drop equipment with skills attached. Time for some population control!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_045

english.description: This is proof that you've become quite familiar with the Library. How to obtain this is kind of a secret, but if you take the time to do a bit of reading now and then, you should be pleasantly surprised.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_046

english.description: This is proof that you've returned alive from challenging all eight Malevolent Crucibles. Since each one only allows certain characters to enter, you'll need mastery of techniques and knowledge for each one of them.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_047

english.description: The squire's pact you'd remembered so fondly is enacted again. What kind of journey will await you this time?
english.name: TROPHY_ID_050

english.description: The time, place, and opponent are different, but the same score has been settled again. This is proof of your efforts.
english.displayName: Severing the Bonds of the Past
english.name: TROPHY_ID_051

english.description: It wasn't quite what you'd expected, was it? Nevertheless, this proves you survived a certain battle.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_052

english.description: Proof that you've cleared Naraka in the Malevolent Crucible. You and your partner make quite a team!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_053

english.description: Proof that you've cleared Naraka in the Malevolent Crucible in a short amount of time. You speed demon, you!
english.name: TROPHY_ID_054

english.description: Proof that you've cleared Naraka in the Malevolent Crucible 11 times.
english.name: TROPHY_ID_055

schinese.description: Either on (at least) your 2nd playthrough or in Hard (or greater) difficulty, conquer the fierce battle at Falkewin Hillside without using any items! It's a steep challenge, but you've got what it takes!
schinese.name: TROPHY_ID_006

schinese.description: Either on (at least) your 2nd playthrough or in Moderate (or greater) difficulty, win the final battle without retrying! If you're familiar with the game, why not start your first playthrough in Moderate right away? You'll earn more Grade than in Normal!
schinese.name: TROPHY_ID_015

schinese.description: Either on (at least) your 3rd playthrough or in Hard (or greater) difficulty, win the final battle without retrying! english.description: The ember from the Cave of Origin in hand, Ophilia embarks on the first leg of the Kindling as the Flamebearer.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_001

english.description: Rite completed, Ophilia helps three quarreling children mend their friendship before setting out for her next destination.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_002

english.description: Ophilia rescues the child kidnapped by the Savior's followers and performs the rite, but she is later betrayed by Lianna. Ophilia must hurry to Wispermill in the Flatlands in pursuit of her sister and the stolen ember.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_003

english.description: The Savior defeated and Lianna saved, Ophilia continues offering guidance to the people of the realm. May the Sacred Flame light your path.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_004

english.description: Driven from the academy, Cyrus sets out to unravel the mystery of From the Far Reaches of Hell, a tome missing for fifteen years.
english.displayName: Setting Out – The Search for Truth
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_005

english.description: After Cyrus solves the mystery of the missing townspeople, he and Odette ascertain where a copy of the tome was reproduced.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_006

english.description: Yvon defeated, Cyrus chases after the mastermind behind the plot: Lucia, the headmaster's secretary.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_007

english.description: After defeating Lucia in the ancient ruins, Cyrus succeeds in deciphering From the Far Reaches of Hell. He continues his research, resolute in his personal mission to see knowledge passed on to future generations.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_008

english.description: Tressa dreams of becoming a renowned merchant. With the mysterious notebook she received from Captain Leon in hand, she sets out on her journey to see all the treasures the world holds.
english.displayName: Setting Out – In Search of Treasure
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_009

english.description: Tressa rescues her rival, Ali, and drives Morlock from the town. Before resuming her journey, Tressa promises Ali they will one day meet again at the Merchants' Fair.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_010

english.description: After reuniting with Leon and hearing him tell of his friend Baltazar, Tressa wonders just what she treasures most. With those thoughts in mind, she makes for Grandport and the Merchants' Fair.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_011

english.description: Content in the knowledge that her journey itself was her treasure all along, Tressa entrusts the next chapter of the journal to Noa and presses on, determined to become a famed merchant.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_012

english.description: The denizens of Cobbleston come out to give their hero Olberic a proper sendoff. The battle with the brigands behind him, Olberic sets out with a renewed sense of purpose.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_013

english.description: Olberic emerges victorious from the tournament and ventures into the desert in pursuit of Erhardt.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_014

english.description: The brief reunion of the twin blades of Hornburg comes to an end as Olberic takes his leave of the desert town in search of his true adversary: the tyrant Werner.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_015

english.description: With Werner defeated, Olberic continues his journey, vowing to protect those in need.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_016

english.description: Primrose, finally in possession of the lead she needed, takes off in pursuit of the three men bearing the mark of the crow—the men against whom she swore revenge.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_017

english.description: Primrose crosses Rufus, the Left-hand Man, off her list and takes the next step in her journey to learn the truth about her father's death.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_018

english.description: With Albus, the Right-hand Man, vanquished, Primrose learns the truth: Simeon, her childhood friend, is responsible for her father's murder.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_019

english.description: Her revenge complete, Primrose sets out anew, vowing to continue dancing.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_020

english.description: With the encouragement of his dear friend Zeph, Alfyn embarks on a journey to heal Orsterra's sick and wounded.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_021

english.description: Alfyn exposes Vanessa's plot to sicken the residents of Goldshore so she may treat them at a premium, and saves a young girl who fell ill by Vanessa's hand. His journey now takes him to Saintsbridge, the largest city in the Riverlands.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_022

english.description: Alfyn's faith in his journey is shaken when a man he helped nearly kills a young boy. Ogen's theory that some lives aren't worth saving echoes in Alfyn's head as he makes his way to the Cliftlands.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_023

english.description: Alfyn cures Ogen and continues on his journey, carrying on the convictions of Graham, the traveling apothecary who once saved Alfyn's own life.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_024

english.description: H'aanit and her trusty snow leopard companion Linde begin their hunt for Master Z'aanta, who has gone missing.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_025

english.description: H'aanit finds Z'aanta turned to stone by the beast known as Redeye. Following the instructions in Z'aanta's letter, she travels to see Susanna the Seeress.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_026

english.description: H'aanit fells a dragon and obtains the herb that should ward off Redeye's curse. Brew in hand, H'aanit makes haste for the desert where Redeye was last seen.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_027

english.description: H'aanit defeats Redeye and at last reunites with her master. Surely this is the first in a long line of tales yet to be told.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_028

english.description: Therion sets out to obtain the three dragonstones in a bargain that would see the fool's bangle marking him a criminal removed.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_029

english.description: Therion vanquishes Orlick to claim the ruby dragonstone before following the trail of the emerald dragonstone to a desert town.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_030

english.description: Therion finds the emerald dragonstone at last, only to have it stolen by none other than Darius, his former partner in crime.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_031

english.description: Therion wrests control of the emerald and gold dragonstones from Darius. His freedom restored, Therion resumes traveling wherever the wind takes him.
english.name: ACHIEVEMENT_032

schinese.description: 欧菲莉亚完成在原初洞窟的考验后，得到了“火种”，并为了式年奉火仪式，以圣火传递者的身份踏上了旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_001

schinese.description: 仪式结束后，欧菲莉亚引导三个在吵架的孩子，亲眼看到他们重归于好后便迈向下一个目的地。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_002

schinese.description: 欧菲莉亚拯救了被“救世主”信徒绑架的孩子，顺利完成仪式，这时莉安娜却袭击了她。欧菲莉亚为了夺回火种，急忙追着莉安娜来到了平原上的村子维斯帕米尔。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_003

schinese.description: 欧菲莉亚讨伐救世主，拯救了莉安娜的心，从今往后也将继续引导众人。——愿圣火指引所有人！
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_004

schinese.description: 赛拉斯被赶出学院，他为了解开１５年前下落不明的《边狱之书》之谜，踏上了旅途。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_005

schinese.description: 赛拉斯调查了在城里发生的失踪案之后，在奥黛特的帮助下，找到了制作《边狱之书》抄本的城市。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_006

schinese.description: 打倒了因滥用《边狱之书》而变成怪物的校长伊冯后，赛拉斯开始追缉主谋——秘书露西亚。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_007

schinese.description: 赛拉斯在古代遗迹深处与露西亚做一个了断，并成功解读《边狱之书》，他秉持着将知识传达给后世的使命而继续探求。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_008

schinese.description: 梦想成为顶尖商人的特蕾莎，怀揣着曾经的大海盗雷欧赠送的无名“手记”，为了寻找前所未见的宝藏踏上了旅途。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_009

schinese.description: 为了救出被抓走的竞争对手阿里，特蕾莎成功驱逐了贪婪的领主，并和阿里立下一起参加“大拍卖会”的誓约后，继续了她的旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_010

schinese.description: 与雷欧重逢时听了雷欧与其摰友巴尔塔扎尔的回忆，特蕾莎虽然还不知道自己的“宝物”究竟是何物，但还是踏上了前往举办“大拍卖会”的城市格兰波特的旅途。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_011

schinese.description: 当特蕾莎明白这一路的旅程本身便是她的“宝物”之后，她决定将手记的后续交托给诺雅，继续着她成为顶尖商人的旅途。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_012

schinese.description: 欧尔贝克从山贼手中拯救了村子，在村民的目送之下踏上了旅程。——为了让自己重新奋起。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_013

schinese.description: 欧尔贝克在武斗大会取得胜利，为了追踪艾尔哈特，前往沙漠。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_014

schinese.description: 与艾尔哈特并肩作战守住了城市的欧尔贝克，为了斩杀真正的仇人——领主维尔纳，而离开了沙漠里的城市。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_015

schinese.description: 斩杀了维尔纳之后，欧尔贝克胸怀“应守护之物”再次开始了他的旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_016

schinese.description: 普里姆萝洁发誓要找到身上有乌鸦刺青的三个男人报仇，循着好不容易到手的线索踏上了旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_017

schinese.description: 普里姆萝洁成功斩杀左腕之男鲁弗斯之后，为了找出父亲死亡的真相，继续踏上复仇之旅。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_018

schinese.description: 普里姆萝洁成功斩杀右腕之男阿尔巴斯之后，知道自己过去的情人席米恩才是真正的凶手——后颈有刺青的男人。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_019

schinese.description: 普里姆萝洁复仇完成之后，发誓要用自己的双腿继续跳舞而再次启程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_020

schinese.description: 在好友杰夫的强烈建议下，为了拯救这片大陆的民众，亚芬踏上了旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_021

schinese.description: 亚芬拆穿黑心药师凡妮莎的阴谋，解救了罹病的少女之后，踏上了前往利维兰多地区最大的城市圣特布里吉的旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_022

schinese.description: 因为自己拯救的男人想要夺走一名无辜少年的生命，亚芬的信念动摇了。反复思考着药师欧根对自己所说的，有些生命不值得拯救这句话，亚芬向着克里夫兰多地区前进。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_023

schinese.description: 拯救了欧根性命的亚芬，带着传承自他恩人旅行药师格拉墨的信念，继续着他的旅途。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_024

schinese.description: 为了找寻恩师闪达的下落，海茵特与搭挡林德一同踏上了旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_025

schinese.description: 海茵特发现了在与“红眼”的战斗中被石化的闪达，循着留在那的一封信中的线索，前去寻找占卜师苏珊娜。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_026

schinese.description: 与龙交战后得到了防止石化药物的海茵特，急忙赶往红眼最后出现的沙漠。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_027

schinese.description: 战胜红眼后，海茵特与闪达重逢。从今以后，海茵特会继续创造出各种各样的故事。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_028

schinese.description: 泰里翁被戴上了罪人的手环，为了拿下手环，他启程前去取回三颗“龙石”。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_029

schinese.description: 泰里翁打倒了奥立克，收回赤龙石之后，前往有绿龙石的沙漠城市。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_030

schinese.description: 泰里翁终于找到了绿龙石，但是却被曾经的好兄弟达留斯拿走了。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_031

schinese.description: 泰里翁从达留斯手中拿回绿龙石与黄龙石获得自由之后，再次踏上了漫无目的的旅程。
schinese.name: ACHIEVEMENT_032
